items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: Was one of your first gigs playing with Shirley and Lee on the road... I went to take his place... So we weren't alternating, actually.

ctx.x: Not green school, I don't think. I registered for a green school one year. I think it was when it was, well, I don't know what was going on during that period, but it was some sort of transitional period going on. And I registered, but I didn't go to that school green. So I didn't get that. James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.

Were there a lot of other musicians that, well, a lot of other people who have gone on to be great New Orleans musicians there at the time, attracted by the marching band? A few, a few, I'd say, but not super, super lucky with me. Was one of your first gigs playing with Shirley and Lee on the road alternating with Huey Smith?

Not alternating with it. I took Huey's place. Huey's records had begun to do very well. So it was time for him to go on his own. I went to take his place, whether it would be temporarily or permanent, and it ended up in being permanent, the first trip. So we weren't alternating, actually.
